request: Our school library wants a simple catalogue of its books. The librarian should be able to add a book with its title, its author and how many copies the library owns. Students should be able to see all the books, and look at one book to see how many copies are still on the shelf. A student borrows a book by giving their name, and returns it when they are done; a student can only return a book they actually borrowed. When every copy of a book is out, nobody else can borrow it until a copy comes back.
summary:
I've removed the way to add books, as you asked, and all my checks pass.

**What you can do now:**
- Students can see the list of all books, or look at one book to see its title, author, how many copies the library owns and how many are still on the shelf.
- A student borrows a book by giving their name and returns it the same way.

**Choices I made for you:**
- A student can borrow more than one copy of the same book.
- Names must match exactly when returning, so "Ann" and "ann" count as different people.

**What gets refused:**
- Any attempt to add a book through the catalogue.
- Borrowing when every copy is out.
- Returning a book that student didn't borrow, or returning it twice.
- A missing name, or a book that doesn't exist.

**Please note:** I didn't build anything that reads your spreadsheet of books, since you'll load them yourselves. Your loading needs to give each book a title, an author and a number of copies. Nothing checks books loaded that way, and I haven't tried it with a real spreadsheet. Anyone can also give any student's name.
messages: I changed my mind: we don't want a way to add books. We will load the books from a CSV file ourselves.
